en.headline: Helicopter airlifts hiker from Lion Rock after morning illness
en.dek: Police said a woman reported that her 17-year-old daughter and two friends were on Lion Rock when one began vomiting and feeling cold.
body: Police received a report at about 6:50am on Saturday that a 17-year-old girl and two companions were hiking on Lion Rock in Wong Tai Sin and that one of them had started vomiting and feeling cold.

Rescue personnel assembled at Lion Rock Country Park. The Government Flying Service deployed a helicopter that lifted the unwell person to the Wan Chai heliport. An ambulance then took her to Ruttonjee Hospital for treatment.

Authorities have not released further details of the hikers’ condition or the exact path they took. The incident comes while a yellow fire danger warning remains in force, and many hiking groups start early to avoid midday heat.

zh.headline: 獅子山行山人士清晨不適 直升機送院
zh.dek: 警方接報指一名17歲少女與兩名友人登獅子山時，其中一人嘔吐及發冷。
body: 警方周六早上約6時50分接獲一名女子報案，指其17歲女兒與兩名友人結伴行獅子山，期間其中一人出現嘔吐及發冷情況。
救援人員在黃大仙獅子山郊野公園集合。政府飛行服務隊派出直升機將不適人士救起，送往灣仔直升機坪，再由救護車轉送律敦治醫院治理。
當局未有進一步公布行山人士的狀況或具體路徑。天文台當日仍有黃色火災危險警告生效，不少行山人士會選擇清晨出發以避開中午高溫。
